title: effusiella erucosa

The health benefits of Effusiella erucosa include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Effusiella erucosa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
